groups.defect: The Lithuanian totpStep1 (account theme) and loginTotpStep1 (login theme) values were replaced with an Italian sentence instead of a Lithuanian translation.
groups.rationale: It is the same copy-paste of the Italian sentence into two Lithuanian files. Each file needs its own edit, and both are fixed by supplying a Lithuanian translation.

groups.defect: The zh_CN totpStep1 value uses Traditional Chinese script instead of Simplified.
groups.rationale: Both point to the same line and report the same script mismatch.

groups.defect: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the admin-ui and account-ui JS-served English bundles was switched from i18next {{n}} placeholders to Java MessageFormat {n}/{2,choice,...} syntax, which the SPAs cannot interpolate and which no longer matches the sibling translations.
groups.rationale: The same syntax change was made in two SPA bundles. All members report the same interpolation breakage, and it is fixed by keeping the {{n}} syntax in the JS bundles.

groups.defect: The common prefix/suffix trimming in the Illegal HTML diagnostic can overlap, so substring is called with begin > end and throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
groups.rationale: Both report the same overlap crash in the same diff-display code and propose clamping the indexes.

groups.defect: verifySafeHtml throws an unchecked RuntimeException when the derived English file is missing, which aborts the verification instead of reporting the problem.
groups.rationale: Both point to the same lines with the same failure mode and the same proposed fix.
